messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: GPU pool 'prod-gpu-a' at 100% utilization, queue depth spiking to ~12k. Autoscaler failing to add new nodes (Scale loop error: 'failed to allocate GPUs'). Paging oncall.

sam: I'm on it. Seeing the same in the dashboard — p95 latency for text-gen routes jumping up. How long has this been trending?

maya: started ~8m ago per traces. Autoscaler logs show repeated 'quota exceeded' when requesting more instances from cloud provider. Also a handful of pods stuck in Pending due to insufficient GPUs.

eli: Confirmed. Cloud provider returning 403 quota error for new GPU instances (we hit regional soft cap). We have reserved capacity in 'reserved-eu' but it's a different region.

kyle: Runtime notes — KV cache eviction is high, model concurrency is backlogged. If we can't spin GPUs, we should fallback to smaller model variants or CPU nodes for non-latency-sensitive routes.

leah: Customer-impact note: a handful of paid customers reported 503s for long responses. CS already triaging. Will escalate externally if we need extended mitigation.

ops-jen: Triage plan: 1) Quick mitigate traffic routing to reduce tail latency 2) Bump emergency capacity (if possible) 3) Drain low-priority batches 4) Manual scaling workarounds.

sam: Doing step 1 now — enabling emergency route fallback for non-enterprise traffic to model-eco variants (lower-cost, smaller context) and diverting batch jobs to off-peak queue. Will post commands.

sam: Command to flip fallback (internal):
```
redwoodctl routing update --route text-gen --fallback-model model-eco-v2 --selector "tier!=enterprise"
```

kyle: :thumbsup: Also enabling sticky-cache TTL increase so repeated prompts hit cache more often.

maya: I'm watching autoscaler controller. Logs:
```
ERROR autoscaler: failed to request instances: 403 QuotaExceeded: GPU quota reached for region-us-west-2
WARN autoscaler: backoff next attempt in 30s
```

eli: Reached out to cloud quotas team — opening emergency quota increase request. ETA unknown. In parallel, we can try cross-region provisioning to 'us-east-1' where we have spare quota.

sam: I'll start cross-region pool creation as manual fallback. Creating a temporary pool 'prod-gpu-fallback-us-east' and set routing policy to prefer us-east for non-data-residency-critical customers.

sam: Command:
```
infractl pool create --name prod-gpu-fallback-us-east --region us-east-1 --instance g5.12x --min 3 --max 30 --labels fallback=true
infractl pool attach-traffic --pool prod-gpu-fallback-us-east --route text-gen --weight 20
```

infra-bot: Pool 'prod-gpu-fallback-us-east' creation started. Provisioning 3 instances.

maya: While provisioning is in flight, let's throttle non-critical batch ingestion. k8s job controller: scale down 'batch-ingest' to 10%.

kyle: Done. Also toggled 'prefer-cpu' for embedding-only workloads to move them off GPUs.

leah: Notifying impacted customers: "We're experiencing degraded performance due to provisioning delays; we've applied mitigations including fallback models and capacity routing. We'll update in 30 minutes." Posting now.

leah: Ping CS pods: any customers requesting immediate data residency constraints? We need to ensure we don't route regulated customers to us-east.

ops-jen: Good catch — we have enterprise customers with region pins. Routing change excludes routes with customer.region_pin=true by default.

eli: Cloud quotas team responded: can raise +10 GPUs in 15 minutes. But that's not enough for current queue. Cross-region pool provision time ~10-12 minutes if instances available.

sam: Current mitigation summary: - Enabled model fallbacks for non-enterprise (reduced p95 by ~30%) - Scaled down batch jobs - Started cross-region pool provisioning - Increased cache TTL - CS notified customers

maya: Monitoring: queue depth dropped from 12k -> 6.5k after fallbacks and batch throttle. Latency still elevated but stabilizing.

kyle: Added temporary circuit-breaker to reject requests > max_tokens 4096 for free-tier to reduce heavy calls.

sam: Requesting oncall handoff in 45 minutes to eli for follow-through once cross-region pool is up.

eli: I'll take the handoff. Follow-up tasks I'll own: confirm cloud quota increase, verify pool health, and initiate postmortem.

ops-jen: Initiating incident severity classification: S2 (partial outage degraded performance for subset of customers). Marking incident start ts=1987659876.

infra-bot: Pool 'prod-gpu-fallback-us-east' successfully provisioned (3 instances). Attaching traffic.

sam: Attaching traffic now -> routing weight increased to 40%. Monitoring impact.

maya: Nice — p95 dropped further, queue at ~2.1k. Autoscaler still backoff for us-west until quota issue resolved.

leah: CS update: customers on fallback reported no functional regressions but noted slightly different latency/quality. No escalations yet.

sam: Quick post-incident actions while current mitigation holds:
- sam: follow-up on cross-region routing runbook (owner: sam, due: 72h)
- eli: request permanent reserved capacity for us-west (owner: eli, due: 7d)
- kyle: evaluate smaller model quality/regression for fallback paths and add to Optimize suggestions (owner: kyle, due: 5d)
- maya: add autoscaler more robust cloud error handling and fallback to cross-region provision (owner: maya, due: 7d)
- ops-jen: update incident doc with timeline and customer impact (owner: ops-jen, due: 24h)

maya: Logging note for postmortem: autoscaler should detect quota-exceeded and automatically start cross-region pool creation after 2 failed attempts. Current behavior is just exponential backoff.

eli: Agreed. Also propose we add a soft-failover policy to maintain a small warm pool in a secondary region for critical tiers.

sam: Handing off to eli now. I'll remain on-call backup until resolved.

eli: Taking over. Monitoring for next 2 hours; if queue doesn't recover to <500, we'll escalate to S1 and open exec notify.

leah: I'll prepare a short customer-facing post-incident note to send once we have final resolution.

ops-jen: Closing loop: incident active -> mitigated at 1987663200 (queue under control, fallbacks in place). Will keep thread open for postmortem notes and action-item tracking.

oncall-bot: Incident annotated: mitigations applied, handoff complete. Next scheduled postmortem sync: 24h from now.

sam: :white_check_mark: Thanks team. Quick debrief in 30m to capture missing logs and timeline.

maya: Adding logs snippet for timeline capture:
```
1987659876 autoscaler: initial spike detected
1987659930 requests: queue 12k
1987660200 routing: fallback enabled
1987660800 infra: cross-region pool requested
1987663000 infra-bot: pool ready
1987663200 queue: 450
```

eli: Saved. Will draft postmortem and ping owners. If anyone notices any fallout from the routing changes, ping me directly.

leah: Will follow up with CS notes and copy into postmortem doc.

ops-jen: Action items logged. Closing incident chat for live coordination. :lock:"
